title: Tesaurus Bahasa Melayu Dewan Edisi Baharu
note: The current Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka thesaurus: about 5,400 main entries and 18,000 subentries. The catalogue dates this edition to 2015, and in 2026 DBP still names Tesaurus Bahasa Melayu Dewan, at this portal, as the thesaurus in its general database. Tepi reads the Tesaurus panel on the Cari1 search. That panel does not print the edition title. A lemma is listed only when the panel's headword is that lemma. Tepi stores the status and, when the panel gives one, the word class. The synonym lists stay on the portal. The thesaurus is much smaller than the dictionary, so a word can be good Malay and still be unlisted.
